responsibility: Contains shared x86 RTL expansion helpers used after generic lowering but before final instruction emission. It owns backend routines for splitting wide integer operands into halves, emitting preferred zeroing idioms, recognizing and expanding vector extract/insert operations through pextr/pinsr instructions, choosing reduction split widths, handling x86-specific constant and broadcast forms, and generating helper libcalls such as divmod, making it the dedicated low-level expansion support file separate from the main target hook implementation in i386.c.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-expand.h, which only exposes the helper types and prototypes, this source file contains the actual shared RTL expansion routines used by the x86 backend, such as operand splitting, vector extract/insert expansion, reduction splitting, and divmod libcall generation.
